bundles.allNote: All bundles, including inactive ones that can be re-activated.

orders.title: Order browser
orders.subtitle: Search every order by status, buyer, course, date, currency or coupon.
orders.courseIdHint: The course's id, as shown in the studio or admin pages.

recon.platformOnlyNote: Platform-only amounts come from courses with no instructor revenue share. They never reach the ledger and are subtracted before the differences are computed.

policy.title: Your commercial limits
policy.note: Set by the platform configuration; the server enforces them on every request.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Edit the catalog tree: names in English and Arabic, parent, sort order and academy flag.
categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; used in the URL.
categories.academyHint: Academies get their own landing page.
categories.deleteBody: Only empty categories can be deleted: no courses, no subcategories and no pathways.

err.invalid_slug: Use 1–100 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens (not starting or ending with a hyphen).
err.slug_taken: This slug is already used by another category.
err.invalid_name: Enter 1–100 characters of plain text (no < or >).
err.invalid_sort_order: Sort order must be a whole number between −100000 and 100000.
err.invalid_parent: The chosen parent does not exist.
err.category_cycle: A category cannot be moved under itself or one of its subcategories.
err.category_too_deep: Categories can be nested at most 4 levels deep.
err.category_has_courses: It still has courses (current or in published course versions). Move those courses to another category first.
err.category_has_children: It has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
err.category_has_pathways: Learning pathways belong to it. Reassign those pathways first.

certCourses.title: Linked courses
certCourses.none: No courses are linked to this certification yet.

mapping.notLinked: This course is not linked to the certification yet; ask a reviewer to link it before mapping.
mapping.preloaded: {n} items are mapped now ({active} counted as covering). Saving replaces the mapping with the boxes ticked below.

notes.note: Live courses and whether their lessons include written notes. Note text is shown only inside the course.

ent.premiumHint: Uses the organization's entitlement; only org admins can grant it.

pathways.title: Assign a learning pathway
pathways.note: A published pathway expands into one course assignment per live course. Courses already assigned to the same people are skipped and listed.
pathways.removeBody: Removes the course assignments created by “{title}”. Assignments that existed before are kept.

materials.note: Files stay private to members: never public, scanned for malware, documents only (no video, audio or archives).
materials.deptHint: Leave empty for everyone in the organization; otherwise only that department (plus managers) can see it.
materials.quotaNote: The server enforces the organization's storage quota and says so if an upload would exceed it.

seats.note: Mastemy staff send an invoice payable by bank transfer. The seat limit rises once the payment is recorded.
seats.qtyRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000.

err.pathway_has_no_live_courses: This pathway has no live courses to assign.
err.duplicate_assignment: This pathway is already assigned to the same people.
err.premium_scope_requires_admin: Only an organization admin can grant premium services.
err.quota_exceeded: This upload would exceed the organization's storage quota. Delete older materials first.
err.malware_detected: The malware scanner flagged this file; it was not stored.
err.seat_request_pending: A seat request is already open. Wait for staff to handle it.
err.invalid_issuer: The issuer must be an absolute https URL.
err.invalid_client_id: Enter the client id (up to 255 characters).
err.invalid_domains: List 1–50 valid email domains, e.g. example.com.
err.invalid_client_secret: A client secret is required when SSO is first configured.
err.seat_limit_below_usage: The seat limit cannot go below the seats in use.
err.fileType: This file type is not allowed (documents only; no video, audio or archives).
err.scanner: The malware scanner is unavailable; try again later.

staffEnt.title: Enterprise seats
staffEnt.subtitle: Turn seat requests into bank-transfer invoices and record payments. Seat limits change only when an order is marked paid.
staffEnt.createNote: Creates a pending order and issues its invoice ("Payment due by bank transfer").
staffEnt.markPaidBody: Record the bank transfer for invoice {number}. The seat limit rises by {n}.

sso.title: Single sign-on (OIDC)
sso.note: Members sign in with your identity provider. Users are created just in time as Members; SAML and SCIM are not supported. Staff accounts cannot use SSO.
sso.none: SSO is not configured for this organization yet.
sso.issuerHint: Must match the issuer in the provider's discovery document.
sso.secretKeep: A secret is stored and never shown. Leave empty to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
sso.secretRequired: Required for the first setup. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
sso.redirectUri: Register this redirect URI at your provider:
sso.serverNotConfigured: SSO is not configured on this Mastemy server yet (no redirect URI), so sign-in will not start.
sso.removeBody: Members will no longer be able to sign in through your provider. Existing accounts are kept.
sso.testNote: Share this link with members, or open it in a private window to test (staff accounts are refused).
sso.orgSlugHint: The short name your administrator gave you, e.g. acme.
sso.orgSlugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

err.generic: Single sign-on failed. Try again or contact your administrator.
err.sso_invalid_state: The sign-in request expired or was already used. Start again.
err.sso_idp_error: Your identity provider reported an error.
err.sso_invalid_request: The identity provider returned an incomplete response.
err.sso_token_exchange_failed: The identity provider rejected the sign-in.
err.sso_invalid_token: The identity token could not be verified.
err.sso_email_missing: Your identity provider did not share a valid email address.
err.sso_email_unverified: Your email address is not verified by your identity provider.
err.sso_domain_not_allowed: Your email domain is not allowed for this organization.
err.sso_link_requires_verified_email: A Mastemy account with this email exists but its email is not verified. Verify it with a password sign-in first.
err.sso_privileged_not_allowed: Staff accounts must sign in with password and two-step verification.
err.sso_provider_unavailable: Your identity provider could not be reached. Try again later.
err.sso_not_available: Single sign-on is not available for this organization.
err.sso_not_configured: Single sign-on is not configured on this server.
err.seat_limit_reached: Your organization has no free seats. Ask an administrator for help.
err.invalid_handoff: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Start again.
